title: CyberWolf Foundations Check
description: A short self-assessment covering networking, operating systems and core security concepts.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of DNS?

options.text: Translate domain names into resource records such as IP addresses

questions.explanation: DNS is a distributed naming system. It commonly resolves hostnames to IP addresses, but it also stores other record types.

questions.prompt: Which characteristic is associated with TCP?

options.text: It is always faster than UDP
It provides a reliable, ordered byte stream

questions.explanation: TCP provides ordered, reliable byte-stream delivery using mechanisms such as sequence numbers, acknowledgments and retransmission. It does not guarantee that it is always faster.

questions.prompt: What does the principle of least privilege recommend?

options.text: Grant only the access needed for an approved task
Share one account across a team

questions.explanation: Least privilege limits access to what is necessary for a role or task, reducing the impact of mistakes and compromised accounts.

questions.prompt: What is a cryptographic hash primarily designed to produce?

options.text: A fixed-length digest from input data

questions.explanation: A cryptographic hash maps input of arbitrary length to a fixed-size digest. It is not encryption and is not designed to be reversed.

questions.prompt: Which CIA property is most directly concerned with preventing unauthorized modification of data?
questions.explanation: Integrity concerns accuracy and protection against unauthorized alteration or destruction of information.
